properties.summary: Illustrative height envelopes: the approved development parcels and lots of Vesting Tentative Map 9693, each drawn whole and raised to the height limit the Orchards Design Guidelines (Nov 2025) set for it: 85 ft in the Mixed-Use District and on the Multi-Family District's B and C parcels, 65 ft on its E, F, G and H parcels, 40 ft on the attached row townhome lots and 35 ft on the single-family lots of the Neighborhood District. They are limits, not building designs; streets, parks and open space parcels are left empty. The existing office campus, to be demolished, isn't drawn.
properties.note: Approved parcels raised to the design guidelines' height limits; real buildings will be smaller.

controls.label: 71 building outlines on sheet C3.0 against OpenStreetMap building footprints (rotation and shift; scale held at 1" = 100'): trimmed RMS over the closest 50% of 14257 points

georeference.start: cross-correlation of the filled outlines: rotation 27.7 deg, 70% of the drawn outline area on mapped buildings

properties.license: Footprints and heights: traced facts from public City of San Ramon records (the PDFs are not redistributed). Georeference: OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL 1.0), via Overture Maps.
